Why It Matters

Built for the Demands of Modern Business

Today's commercial environments generate waste at an unprecedented pace. Whether you manage a single storefront or hundreds of locations, having a reliable waste partner is no longer optional — it's a competitive advantage. At Tenth Rock, we combine local vendor expertise with enterprise-scale coordination so your operations never miss a beat. Our approach eliminates the fragmented vendor relationships that drain your team's time and budget, replacing them with a single, accountable point of contact.

  • Reduce waste management overhead by up to 30%
  • Eliminate multi-vendor coordination headaches
  • Real-time reporting and compliance documentation
  • Scalable solutions that grow with your business

Our Process

How It Works

A simple, transparent process designed to get your problem solved fast.

Our Commitment

Sustainability Without Compromise

Environmental responsibility and operational efficiency aren't mutually exclusive. Our waste diversion programs help businesses meet sustainability goals without sacrificing service quality or increasing costs. We partner with certified recycling and processing facilities across the country to maximize diversion rates while maintaining the reliability your operations depend on. Every ton diverted from landfills is tracked, documented, and reported — giving your team the data needed for ESG reporting and regulatory compliance.

  • Certified waste diversion and recycling programs
  • Detailed sustainability reporting for ESG compliance
  • Partnerships with local processing facilities
  • Zero-waste consultation available for qualifying clients
